messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened a docs PR that clarifies the runtime fallback behavior for quantized models and adds a small SDK example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 :eyes:

maria: The main thing I changed is the README paragraph that explained "automatic fallback" — I expanded it to list the three fallback tiers (model-variant, region, cpu-quant), and added a tiny code snippet showing how to set `fallback_policy` in the SDK config.

sam: skimmed — looks fine overall. one question: are we sure about calling it `cpu-quant` in the docs? runtime uses `quant-cpu` internally iirc. mixing terms might confuse support.

maria: good catch. the runtime flag is `quant-cpu` — I used `cpu-quant` in the prose to sound less like an internal flag but i can switch to the canonical name. prefer canonical.

alex: I can take a pass to tighten the wording. also we should add a tiny bench note: expected latency bump when falling back to quant-cpu for small seqs (like +30-70ms on our 8xA10 profile). customers care about orders of magnitude.

ivy: sdk snippet LGTM, but needs a language variant for python + go. current snippet is TS. also add a note to prefer `prefer_model_variant` ordering in the policy if you want quality-first behavior.

maria: plan: switch to canonical names, add alex's bench line (short), add python snippet, and re-run link checker. will push update in an hour. anyone want to pair-review before I merge?

sam: happy to quick pass after you push. :thumbsup:

alex: I can review wording. maybe remove the sentence that suggests `always-on` prefix caching — that's not universally enabled.

maria: yep removed that sentence in the branch. pushed a new commit 37a9b2.

deploy-bot: lint check passed for docs repo (commit 37a9b2) — 0 warnings, 1 new file added.

ivy: pushed a python snippet suggestion in a followup commit. also added a one-liner showing how to set `fallback_policy: ["prefer_model_variant", "quant-cpu"]` inside the YAML example.

maria: sweet, updated PR description to include a changelog entry and the bench numbers alex suggested. last ask: can someone from support double-check the compatibility table row for "quantized variants" — I kept the original notes but clarified the supported runtimes.

sam: tagging @support in the PR (done).

alex: lgtm from docs POV, small nit removed.

maria: thanks all. merging later today unless any objections. will also add a follow-up to docs/README migration guide for Dedicated customers explaining how fallback interacts with reserved pools.

ivy: thanks — nice to have that explicit. :raised_hands:

maria: merged. closing thread.
